title: Coefficient transition of selected reindexing models
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite and $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ with $\ell$ invertible where constructibility is used. Use [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence] [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models] [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems] [def-pod-scalar-completion-tensor-comparisons]. For finite coefficient fields E,L and an embedding, selected models D,T over E and D',T' over L, a coefficient transition consists of the ordinary scalar/reindexing comparison, source and target quotient/Roos-normalized scalar realizations and preservation of complete constructibility. The ordinary map is fixed on sheafified pure tensors. Its laws are the displayed whole-system reduction square, total-limit square and completed-tensor square for these same D.reduction,D.limit,T.tensor and D'.reduction,D'.limit,T'.tensor. Scalar/reduction and scalar/limit maps are defined by the actual scalar completion and coherent counit formulas.
